name: synthetic
description: Synthetic hand-checked set (US-93): 16 made-up papers in two courses, written to look like extracted past papers. Every gold group was decided by hand. It mixes copies the grouping should catch (renumbering, marks, case, spacing, one-letter typos), copies it cannot catch yet (rewording, word order, hyphens and apostrophes; the target of US-15b), and different questions that must stay apart (other numbers, IPv4 and IPv6, CSMA/CD and CSMA/CA). Safe to publish: no real exam text.

notes.tcp-handshake: Includes 'Describe how TCP sets up a connection with a three-way handshake.': a rewording of the same question, so it is gold-grouped with the others.
notes.tcp-congestion: 'slow-start' with a hyphen is the same question as 'slow start'.
notes.tcp-udp-compare: 'Compare UDP and TCP' asks the same thing as 'Compare TCP and UDP'.
notes.osi-layers: 'Name the 7 layers' is the same question as 'List the seven layers'.
notes.subnet-4: Kept apart from subnet-8: a different number of subnets is a different question.
notes.dijkstra: 'Dijkstras' without the apostrophe is the same question.
notes.arp-purpose: 'What's' and 'What is' are the same question.
notes.dns-resolution: 'host name' and 'hostname' are the same question.
notes.routing-figure: Two-part question; both copies have the same parts.
notes.interval-3n: Kept apart from interval-2n: a different series is a different question. 'Find the radius and interval of convergence' is gold-grouped here because the interval is what is asked in both.
notes.ratio-series: 'Determine if' and 'Determine whether' are the same question.
notes.maclaurin-ln: 'Taylor series ... about x = 0' is the Maclaurin series, so the same question.
notes.alt-error-0001: Kept apart from alt-error-001: a different accuracy is a different question.
notes.taylor-sqrt: The same question with its two halves in the other order.
